**Class 21 Practice Assignment** A gas mixture at 140 ºC and 1.0 atm and containing 30% A and 70% B is fed to a steady-state PFR at a flow rate of 0.45 L min^−1^. The PFR diameter is 4 cm and there is no pressure drop along its length. An external fluid, also at a temperature of 140 ºC, is fed at a rate of 20  g min^−1^ to a perfectly mixed shell surrounding the reactor tube. The heat capacity of that fluid is 1.4 J g^–1^ K^–1^, and the heat transfer coefficient is 1.3 x 10^–6^ kJ min^−1^ cm^−2^ K^−1^.

Reactions (1) and (2) occur within the reactor at a space time of 20 min. The rate expressions for the reactions are given in equations (3) and (4). The pre-exponential factors for reactions (1) and (2) are equal to 1.65 × 10^4^ mol min^−1^ cm^−3^ atm^−2^ and 3.24 × 10^4^ mol min^−1^ cm^−3^ atm^−2^, respectively. The activation energies for reactions (1) and (2) are equal to 78 kJ mol^−1^ and 86 kJ mol^−1^, respectively. The standard heats of reactions (1) and (2) are −35.1 kJ mol^−1^ and −32.6 kJ mol^−1^, respectively. The heat capacities of the reagents, in J mol^−1^ K^−1^, are A: 78.3, B: 81.1, D: 75.4, Z: 68.3 and U: 76.3.

$$
A + B \rightarrow D + Z \tag{1}
$$

$$
D + B \rightarrow U + Z \tag{2}
$$

$$
r_1 = k_1 P_A P_B \tag{3}
$$

$$
r_2 = k_2 P_D P_B \tag{4}
$$

What are the conversion of A, the selectivity for D over U, the outlet temperature, and the outlet exchange fluid temperature?
